heroHeadline: Heritage Damage Reports and Border-Construction Protests Deepen Cambodia's Case Against Thailand
heroSubtitle: Cambodia lodged a fresh protest on September 8 listing Thai house demolitions, bunker construction and well drilling across Banteay Meanchey and Oddar Meanchey since late August, alongside a statement arguing the ceasefire is 'not a title deed to territory.' A joint UNESCO-ICOMOS mission report published September 9 found 'incomparable' war damage across 560-plus areas of Preah Vihear temple, and Cambodia's Mine Action Centre followed up September 10 saying Thai forces struck 501 targets there with artillery, cluster munitions, drones and mortars. The Information Ministry also renewed calls for the safe return of 6,066 displaced children. The December 27 ceasefire continues to hold in form.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
